settings.title: Polling settings
settings.subtitle: Enable or disable each polling job across the whole NetMaster instance. For debugging only.
settings.backgroundJobsDescription: Server-side jobs that run continuously in the NetMaster process, independent of any open browser tab.
settings.liveViewsDescription: Client-side polling that only runs while the relevant page is open in a browser.
settings.serverMetricsDescription: CPU, memory, disk and network stats collected via SSH (per-server interval, default 30s).
settings.dockerContainersDescription: Container list per server (SSH) - only polled automatically while Advanced Polling is active, otherwise via manual refresh.
settings.dockerImagesDescription: Docker image list per server (SSH), polled at the per-server VM/Docker interval (default 120 min).
settings.proxmoxVmsDescription: VM and container status via Proxmox - only polled automatically while Advanced Polling is active, otherwise via manual refresh.
settings.routerDevicesDescription: FritzBox / Repeater status via TR-064 (per-device interval, default 60s).
settings.discoveryScanDescription: Scheduled network scan (Explore). Also requires auto-scan to be enabled in Explore settings.
settings.topologyGraphDescription: Live topology graph on the Network page (refreshes every 20s while open).
settings.portsDescription: Ports/connections card and graph on a server's detail page (refreshes every 15s while open).
settings.dashboardLookupsDescription: Server/VM/container name lookups for dashboard widgets (refreshes every 60s while open).
settings.wsProcessesDescription: Live process list in a server's process manager (refreshes every 2.5s while open).
settings.pingDescription: Centralized ICMP reachability check from the NetMaster server against known VM/container IPs - no SSH load on the target host.
settings.pingIntervalDescription: How often known VM/container IPs are pinged.
